description: The file defines an OkHttp interceptor for adding Bearer token authentication to API requests, along with an interface for token provision and a stub implementation.

classes.name: AuthInterceptor
classes.description: An OkHttp interceptor that adds Bearer token authentication to outgoing API requests.

classes.name: TokenProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing authentication tokens, allowing different implementations for token retrieval.

classes.name: StubTokenProvider
classes.description: A placeholder implementation of TokenProvider that returns null tokens, meant to be replaced with actual token retrieval logic.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Intercepts API requests to add Bearer token headers if a token is available.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the current authentication token or null if none is available.
